disposition_reason: Table 1 sets lead 0.5 mg/kg for 'Cocoa products, chocolate and chocolate products and candies'; Table 4 sets total arsenic 0.5 mg/kg (no inorganic As limit) for 'Cocoa products, chocolate and chocolate products'. Appendix A places cocoa beans in 'Nuts and seeds', whose lead ML is 0.2 mg/kg. No cadmium, mercury, nickel or chromium limit covers cocoa.
disposition_locator: Table 1 Lead (PDF pp. 5-6); Table 4 Arsenic (PDF p. 10); Appendix A food categories (PDF pp. 17, 21); report highlights p. 1
